stories.title: North Wales Police warns of fake bank call and WhatsApp scam
stories.summary: North Wales Police has warned people not to share bank details after a scam involving fake fraud calls followed by WhatsApp messages. The force’s Cyber Crime Team said fraudsters are phoning victims claiming to be from their bank’s fraud team. stories.title: North Wales force’s handling of rural crime and emergency calls examined by PCC
stories.summary: North Wales Police’s handling of rural crime and how quickly officers respond to emergency calls faced scrutiny at the force’s latest Strategic Executive Board meeting. Police and Crime Commissioner Andy Dunbobbin held the session with Chief Constable Amanda Blakeman KPM and other senior officers. stories.title: Garden waste collections delayed to evening across Flintshire today
stories.summary: Flintshire households due a brown bin collection today will have their garden waste collected this evening instead of during the day. stories.title: Flintshire council committee set to consider Pentre Moch name change for Northop Hall
stories.summary: A Flintshire village could soon adopt the historical Welsh name Pentre Moch – or Pig Holding. The request to formally move Pentre Moch as the formal Welsh name for Northop Hall will be considered by Flintshire County Council’s Corporate Resources Overview and Scrutiny Committee on Thursday.
